title: 122 kg ganja seized, 2 persons arrested in West Bengal
summary: Police in West Bengal's South 24 Parganas district seized 122 kilograms of ganja. Two individuals, Faridul Piyada and Sahebur Rahman Molla, were arrested during the operation. The seizure occurred on Friday night following a tip-off and a police raid....

contentHtml:
Diamond Harbour (WB): Police have seized 122 kg of ganja and arrested two persons from West Bengal's South 24 Parganas district, an officer said on Saturday.

Acting on a tip-off, a joint team of the Diamond Harbour Police and Magrahat police raided an under-construction house near a waterbody at Jukdia on Friday night and seized 122 kg of ganja, the officer said.

The two arrested persons were identified as Faridul Piyada and Sahebur Rahman Molla, both residents of Jukdia area, police said.

Diamond Harbour Superintendent of Police Chandrasekhar Bardhan said the raid was conducted following specific intelligence inputs and 122 kg of ganja was seized.

"An investigation is underway to ascertain the source of the contraband, those involved in its supply and whether a larger network is operating behind the drug trade," the SP said.

The police have already gathered some leads and are working to identify other persons allegedly linked to the supply network, Bardhan said.
